title: task.read output
description: Nonblocking lifecycle truth of one delegated worker. The phase comes from the durable delegation row and liveness from the live supervisor; a worker that cannot be proven finished is never reported completed.

answer.description: The child's last observed human-readable answer from the durable history, bounded to 8192 characters. Null is honest absence, never a fabricated completion.

summary.description: The child's own final result summary from the last typed Result event, verbatim and bounded. Null is honest absence.

eventSequence.description: Durable event sequence of the typed Result event this receipt projects — the evidence identity of the completion observation.

result.description: The child's last observed structured completion result: the last typed Result event the child session published, verbatim and bound to its event sequence. Null is honest absence — facts are never scraped from prose.

stalls.description: The model lane (provider/model) of each stall the kernel recovered, in order. Absent when the worker never stalled.

switchedTo.description: The seat's next declared lane (provider/model) the kernel moved the worker to after a repeated stall. Absent while it runs on provider/model.

screen.description: The newest lines of the worker's terminal screen, credential-shaped words withheld. Present when the read asked for it and the worker has a terminal.

branch.description: The live worker's branch, its base commit, git diff --stat and the diff of its capsule against the base, each bounded with a truncation note. Absent when the worker has no Git capsule or has stopped.
